chapters.title: Begin with the whole journey
chapters.text: A flight price is only one part of a trip. Travel Estimator brings transport, accommodation, daily spending, extras, and a contingency into one explained planning budget.

chapters.title: Keep the source visible
chapters.text: Base costs are illustrative estimates. Configured providers can return dated flight quotes and venue information. The interface distinguishes those sources instead of presenting every number as a current booking price.

chapters.title: Protect the selected quote
chapters.text: Before applying a flight, the server checks who selected it, the route, travel dates, and party size. A selection older than fifteen minutes must be refreshed. The browser cannot simply invent verified quote metadata.

chapters.title: Make the price basis explicit
chapters.text: For example, seven hundred dollars at an assumed rate of two hundred eighty Pakistani rupees becomes one hundred ninety-six thousand rupees for a group. If it is a per-person fare, two travellers double that flight amount.

chapters.title: Replace once, then recalculate
chapters.text: The selected flight replaces the sample transport line once. Other costs remain. The subtotal and contingency are recalculated, while baggage, transfers, and seller fees still need separate confirmation.

chapters.title: Be honest when data is missing
chapters.text: A provider may return no photos, no usable offers, or a quota error. The app explains that result. It does not replace missing live data with invented bargains. A saved plan is a snapshot, not a reservation.
